near_boundary_slice: Post-generation diagnostic only: applicable family with required historical eligibility and exactly one numeric atomic condition failing. Counts are within 1 below a lower bound; ratios within 10% of the fixed positive threshold on the failing side. For upper bounds use 10% above. S4 amount outside band within 5% of its endpoint; exact sign/variation failures reported separately. N3: topology present but every route fails full monetary conjunction; report separately without claiming a unique closest path. N4 missing anchor reported separately, not called a near numeric boundary. Union target0 is required for FPR; otherwise count cross-family positives. No slice definition affects sampling.
scope: Twelve matched strata retain all H1-H8 concepts; H1 covers S1/S3, H2 S2, H3 S4, H4 N1, H5 N2/N4, H6 N3, H7 A1/A3, H8 A2/A4. Origin is private and not a class.
